proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding Right to Act by Written Consent
proposals.topic_summary: Requests board take steps to permit shareholders holding the minimum votes needed to act to do so by written consent, with full power to initiate topics.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding Enhancing Proxy Access
proposals.topic_summary: Requests proxy access aggregation of 3% stock held three years, allowing nominees up to 25% of authorized directors, enabling more shareholders to aggregate shares.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding Report on Lobbying Activities
proposals.topic_summary: Requests annual report disclosing Pfizer's direct and indirect lobbying policies, payments, trade association and model legislation memberships, and oversight processes.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding Independent Chair Policy
proposals.proponent: The Sisters of St. Francis of Philadelphia
proposals.topic_summary: Requests policy requiring the Board Chair, whenever possible, to be an independent director, phased in at the next CEO transition.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding Gender Pay Gap
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on Pfizer's global median gender pay gap and related policy, reputational, competitive, operational and talent retention risks.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.
